component.name: ShadowCypher
component.summary: Enterprise offensive security and autonomous intelligence suite

description.p: ShadowCypher is a GTK3 desktop application for professional security practitioners. It provides a unified platform for network reconnaissance, vulnerability assessment, exploit research, wireless security testing, and digital forensics.

ul.li: Shadow AI — voice and text assistant powered by Claude, with offline KB fallback
Guardian — endpoint monitoring with real-time incident detection
Community Chat — global and team chat with Supabase Realtime
Recon Engine — OSINT, DNS, IP reputation, breach checking
Network Scanner — device discovery, port scanning, service fingerprinting
ShadowScript — custom security automation scripting language

description.p: Added community chat (Discord-style global and team rooms), Shadow AI cloud backend via Claude Haiku, web search integration, and Guardian Android app crash fixes.
